purpose: 직접 비교 조작의 전·중·후 상태를 보여 주는 맥락 그림

assets.prompt: Create a clean 16:9 educational game scene for Korean elementary grade 3 math about directly comparing capacity. No text, no numbers, no letters, no labels, no UI, no characters. On a simple purple tabletop, show two upright transparent containers before pouring: on the left, a tall narrow glass bottle filled completely with bright turquoise water; on the right, a clearly larger wide transparent glass jar that is completely empty. The physical sizes must make it obvious the whole smaller bottle can fit inside the larger jar. Polished friendly 3D illustration, dark indigo background, soft rim lighting, uncluttered composition, tablet-readable.
